retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait with bold, geometric sans-serif typography layered across the center of the subject.
excludeWhen: handwritten or script fonts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast studio portrait of a male subject in a dynamic lean, featuring a heavy vignette and two-tier bold typography that spans the horizontal width of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's torso and head occupy the vertical center
Primary text acts as a horizontal belt across the subject's chest
Secondary text is nested directly below the primary text with right-alignment
Vignette focuses light on the subject's face and the central text block
coreInvariants: Geometric sans-serif typography with tight letter spacing
Subject looking directly at the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, slightly leaning forward, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the bold white text, then to the smaller colored subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark vignette in the corners creates a spotlight effect on the center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale/Desaturated tones for the background and subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purple or deep violet for the subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and the dark clothing of the subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with different weights and colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric proportions and clean terminals.
Provides the circular geometry and heavy weight.
A widely available alternative with similar geometric bones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated monochrome studio portrait of a male subject wearing a vest, leaning forward against a light gray background with a heavy dark vignette in the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the center. The top line should be large, bold, and white with very tight tracking. The second line should be smaller, extra bold, and muted purple, aligned to the right edge of the top line.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking tight enough that letters almost touch?
Is the image desaturated or monochrome?
Is the vignette strong enough to darken the corners significantly?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the text is not a direct copy of existing album titles
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text is legible against the subject
Verify the purple accent color is desaturated to match the mood
Ensure the subject's face is the brightest part of the photo
Confirm the geometric sans-serif has no serifs or decorative elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Geometric Sans-Serif Overlay + Tight Tracking + Center-Right Hierarchy
